mapper.select: SELECT c.room_no, c.item_no, c.buyer_email, c.seller_email, c.reg_time, i.title AS item_title, i.status AS item_status, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_review r WHERE r.room_no = c.room_no) AS reviewed FROM tbl_chat_room c JOIN tbl_market_item i ON c.item_no = i.item_no WHERE c.item_no = #{itemNo} AND c.buyer_email = #{buyerEmail} AND c.seller_email = #{sellerEmail}

SELECT c.room_no, c.item_no, c.buyer_email, c.seller_email, c.reg_time, i.title AS item_title, i.status AS item_status, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_review r WHERE r.room_no = c.room_no) AS reviewed FROM tbl_chat_room c JOIN tbl_market_item i ON c.item_no = i.item_no WHERE c.buyer_email = #{memberEmail} OR c.seller_email = #{memberEmail} ORDER BY c.reg_time DESC

SELECT c.room_no, c.item_no, c.buyer_email, c.seller_email, c.reg_time, i.title AS item_title, i.status AS item_status, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_review r WHERE r.room_no = c.room_no) AS reviewed FROM tbl_chat_room c JOIN tbl_market_item i ON c.item_no = i.item_no WHERE c.room_no = #{roomNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_chat_room (item_no, buyer_email, seller_email) VALUES (#{itemNo}, #{buyerEmail}, #{sellerEmail})
